title: Sequential Probability Ratio Test for Audit-Budget-Efficient Monitoring

original_idea.body:
# Sequential Probability Ratio Test for Audit-Budget-Efficient Monitoring

**Problem:** Auditing every action is too costly; too few misses sabotage. Control protocols need to decide on the fly how many checks an action warrants.

**Direction:** Apply Wald's SPRT. For each flagged action, accumulate evidence from cheap repeated monitor queries until the log-likelihood ratio crosses a threshold, giving minimum samples per decision. Benchmark monitor-calls-per-decision vs fixed-N on replayed trajectories.

**Why it matters:** Brings provably sample-optimal stopping to resample/defer control protocols, cutting audit cost at fixed safety. Statistics-only, on logged trajectories.

**Relevant context:** Wald SPRT; Ctrl-Z (arXiv:2504.10374); Evaluating Control Protocols (arXiv:2511.02997).
